subject: mathematics
title: Simultaneous linear equations
summary: Find two unknowns from two equations, by elimination and by substitution.

lesson.text: Simultaneous equations are two equations with the same two unknowns. The answer is the pair of values (x and y) that makes both true at the same time.
Add or subtract the equations so that one unknown disappears.

lesson.title: x + y = 10 and x − y = 4
steps: Add the two equations: the y's cancel. 2x = 14.
Put x = 7 into x + y = 10: 7 + y = 10, so y = 3.

lesson.title: y = 2x and x + y = 9
steps: Replace y with 2x in the second: x + 2x = 9.

lesson.title: 2 pens and 1 book cost ₦700. 1 pen and 1 book cost ₦500.
steps: Let a pen be p and a book b: 2p + b = 700 and p + b = 500.
200 + b = 500, so b = 300. A pen costs ₦200 and a book ₦300.

lesson.text: Check your pair in both equations. If it works in only one, you made a slip.

questions.prompt: Solve: x + y = 9 and x − y = 1
questions.explanation: Add: 2x = 10, so x = 5. Then 5 + y = 9, y = 4. x = 4, y = 5 fails the second equation (4 − 5 = −1).
Subtract the second from the first: x = 4. Then 4 + y = 7, so y = 3. Check: 8 + 3 = 11 ✓

questions.prompt: If y = 3x and x + y = 12, what is y?
questions.explanation: Substitute: x + 3x = 12, 4x = 12, x = 3. Then y = 3 × 3 = 9. (3 is x, not y.)

questions.prompt: The sum of two numbers is 20 and their difference is 6. What is the bigger number?
questions.explanation: Let the numbers be a and b: a + b = 20 and a − b = 6. Add: 2a = 26, so a = 13, and b = 7. 26 is 2a, not a.
